metadata.name: cross_gate
metadata.description: Opening Cross gate: allowlist passes and time locks, enforced as a Token-2022 transfer hook and as a Token ACL (sRFC-37) gate.

instructions.name: allow_wallet
docs: Lifts a denial.

instructions.name: can_freeze_permissionless
docs: Token ACL: may anyone freeze `owner`'s account? Yes if the mint is allowlisted and the
owner holds no pass (for example after the pass was revoked).

instructions.name: can_thaw_permissionless
docs: Token ACL: may `owner`'s frozen account be thawed without the issuer? Yes if the mint is
open or the owner holds a pass.

instructions.name: claim_pass
docs: Self-service pass: anyone may submit a wallet's SAS attestation; if it was issued under the
gate's credential and schema for that wallet and has not expired, the wallet gets a pass.

instructions.name: claim_pass_attested
docs: Self-service pass from an issuer-signed identity attestation (`oc-identity` v1) and,
when the gate has an accreditation attester, an accreditation attestation. Anyone may
submit a wallet's attestations; the terms come from the attestation, not the caller.

instructions.name: claim_pass_merkle
docs: Self-service pass from an allowlist: anyone may submit the proof for a wallet.

instructions.name: claim_pass_merkle_terms
docs: Self-service pass from a terms-bearing allowlist: anyone may submit the proof.

instructions.name: close_lock
docs: Closes an expired lock. Anyone may call; rent returns to the gate authority.

instructions.name: create_config
docs: Creates the gate configuration for `mint`. Must be signed by the mint authority.

instructions.name: deny_wallet
docs: Blocks a wallet from obtaining a pass (sanctions hit, court order, issuer decision).

instructions.name: execute
docs: Transfer hook: called by Token-2022 during every transfer.

instructions.name: grant_pass
docs: Grants `owner` a pass for the mint.

instructions.name: grant_pass_terms
docs: The authority grants a pass with terms. The same issuance rules apply: an authority
cannot violate its own rules without publicly changing them.

instructions.name: init_gate_metas
docs: Writes the Token ACL thaw and freeze extra-account-meta lists.

instructions.name: init_hook_metas
docs: Writes the transfer-hook extra-account-meta list. The mint's hook must point here.

instructions.name: init_rules
docs: Switches the gate to compliance rules and reallocates the config account to hold them.
`rules.passes` is the number of live passes issued before the rules existed.

instructions.name: open_volume
docs: Opens the affiliate-volume account of a wallet whose terms carry the affiliate flag. Anyone
may pay for it. `issue` opens it with the pass, so this is for a wallet that became an
affiliate afterwards (a refreshed attestation) or for a gate that switched the volume limit
on after the pass was issued; until it exists such a wallet cannot transfer.

instructions.name: receive_locked
docs: After a gated cross pays base tokens to `owner`, applies the gate's resale-lock policy:
the received amount is locked for the policy's duration, on top of any lock still active.

accounts.name: cross
docs: The cross. Only `cross_core` can sign for one of its accounts.

instructions.name: refresh_terms
docs: Anyone re-reads a wallet's attestations and updates its terms in place (a changed tier,
cap or expiry). The identity cannot change, and the new terms must satisfy the rules.

instructions.name: release_allocation
docs: Returns reserved allocation (a cancel or a refund). It never fails for want of an account
and never fails on arithmetic, so a refund can always be paid.

accounts.name: cross
docs: The cross. Only `cross_core` can sign for one of its accounts.

instructions.name: reserve_allocation
docs: Reserves `amount` quote atoms of a wallet's per-identity allocation in `cross`. Only the
cross program can sign for the `cross` account. A gate with no cap for these terms
reserves nothing and succeeds.

accounts.name: cross
docs: The cross. Only `cross_core` can sign for one of its accounts.

instructions.name: revoke_denied
docs: Anyone closes the pass of a wallet the compliance officer has denied.

instructions.name: revoke_expired
docs: Anyone closes a pass whose terms have expired, or whose SAS attestation no longer holds.

instructions.name: revoke_nonconforming
docs: Anyone closes a pass whose terms no longer satisfy the current rules.

instructions.name: revoke_pass
docs: Revokes a pass and returns its rent to the authority.

instructions.name: revoke_pass_terms
docs: The authority closes a pass with whatever hangs off it (terms, identity binding, volume).
Also revokes passes issued before the rules existed (their terms account does not exist).

instructions.name: revoke_unattested
docs: Anyone may revoke a pass whose SAS attestation has expired or been closed. The rent goes
back to the pass owner. Passes granted directly by the authority are unaffected unless the
gate requires SAS and the owner has no valid attestation.

instructions.name: set_allowlist_root
docs: Sets (or clears) the allowlist Merkle root.

instructions.name: set_lock
docs: Creates or strengthens a lock. While a lock is active its amount can only rise and its
unlock time can only move later; once expired it may be replaced freely.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The gate authority or the rules' lock delegate; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: set_rules
docs: Replaces the rules. The live-pass counter is kept; everything else is the authority's.

instructions.name: set_sas_requirement
docs: Sets (or clears) the SAS credential and schema that entitle wallets to passes.

instructions.name: update_hook_metas
docs: Rewrites the mint's transfer-hook extra-account-meta list to the layout the rules need, which
adds the sender's terms and affiliate volume and the receiver's terms to the three accounts
every list carries. A gate must run it once after `init_rules`: until then the hook refuses
transfers (it fails closed rather than skip the rules). Gates without rules keep the short
list, so clients of existing hooked mints are unaffected.

types.name: AffiliateLimit
docs: Rule-144-style volume limit for affiliate-flagged wallets: at most `max_amount` token atoms
may leave such a wallet in any `window_secs` window.

types.name: Denied
docs: A wallet the compliance officer has blocked from holding a pass.

fields.name: sas
docs: Solana Attestation Service credential and schema whose attestations entitle a wallet to a
pass (`claim_pass`). `None` disables self-service passes.

fields.name: allowlist_root
docs: Merkle root of an allowlist; leaves are `sha256(0x00 ‖ mint ‖ owner)` (`claim_pass_merkle`).

types.name: LockPolicy
docs: Resale lock applied to tokens a wallet receives from a gated cross.

types.name: PassClosed
docs: `reason`: 0 authority, 1 expired, 2 no longer conforms, 3 denied, 4 attestation gone.

types.name: Rules
docs: The issuer's rules for who may hold the token and how. `passes` is a counter the program
maintains; everything else is set by the gate authority.

fields.name: countries
docs: Bit `n` set = ISO 3166-1 numeric code `n` is on the list.

fields.name: min_tier
docs: Minimum tier (0 = any). Tiers: 1 retail, 2 accredited or professional, 3 qualified.

fields.name: required_flags
docs: Flags every holder must carry.

fields.name: one_identity_one_pass
docs: A second wallet of an identity that already holds a live pass is refused.

fields.name: max_passes
docs: Investor cap: live passes may not exceed this (0 = no cap).

fields.name: passes
docs: Live passes issued under these rules. Maintained by the program.

fields.name: default_cap
docs: Per-identity cap in quote atoms applied when a wallet's terms carry none (0 = no cap).

fields.name: issuance_start
docs: Passes can only be issued inside this window (0 = unbounded on that side).

fields.name: identity
docs: Issuer-signed identity attestations (`oc-identity` v1) that entitle a wallet to a pass.

fields.name: accreditation
docs: Issuer-signed accreditation attestations (`oc-accreditation` v1).

fields.name: allowlist_root
docs: Merkle root of terms-bearing allowlist leaves.

fields.name: lock_delegate
docs: May call `set_lock` (never weakening) besides the authority: a keeper that applies resale
locks.

fields.name: blackouts
docs: Transfers by affiliate-flagged wallets are refused inside these windows.

types.name: Terms
docs: What a pass carries: who the holder is (never PII), where, what tier, which flags, how much it
may buy per cross, and when the pass lapses. Created with the pass by the `*_terms` family.

types.name: TermsData
docs: The terms a pass carries. Also the instruction argument that supplies them.

fields.name: identity
docs: Identity id (all zero = none): unique per person per attester, never PII.

fields.name: country
docs: ISO 3166-1 numeric (0 = unknown).

fields.name: cap
docs: Per-identity cap in quote atoms per cross (0 = use the gate default).

fields.name: expires_ts
docs: The pass lapses at this unix time (0 = never).
